objections.claim: The pre-execution authenticity mechanism is circular and therefore unsatisfiable as written. Section 4 requires the source tarball and history bundle to be verified before extraction or execution using PYLAE's in-process node:crypto hashing plus `gh attestation verify`, but the only PYLAE executable is inside the still-unverified source release; the component tgz is explicitly not standalone. No independently authenticated bootstrap verifier exists to compute and validate the digests, parse the attestation identity, or create the receipt before archive-controlled code runs. This leaves the signed-installable-artifact requirement dependent on executing the artifact it is meant to authenticate. Add an out-of-artifact verifier rooted in operator-trusted bytes/tools, and require a regression proving that digest, attestation identity, and trust-root checks complete before any archive byte is extracted or executed.
